name: morning-log
description: Start a low-friction morning rapid log without inventing entries or silently writing a journal.

# Morning daily log

Read `.github/routine-guidance.md` and follow it. Offer a short morning capture prompt for a task, note, or event using the rapid-log syntax in `SCHEMA.md`. If the user provides entries and asks to record them, follow `/log`; preserve their wording, date, and signifiers. Otherwise do not create an empty journal or repeat an earlier capture. Give one primary next action, or let the user skip.
